regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA threat index 2.22 (STABLE, steady): Iran, Oman tensions

bullets.text: Iran is experiencing military conflict, with ongoing war efforts impacting global oil prices
Oman is engaged in diplomatic talks with Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz route, aiming to ease regional tensions
The Iran-Oman dynamic is driving the current MENA threat index, with other countries like Sudan and Egypt facing separate security challenges

markets.headline: Index forecast rising; Brent +0.2%; gold +0.1%; VIX +1.2% (model estimate).
markets.method_note: Threat beta = OLS of daily log-returns on the index change at the lead lag; launch-day estimates lean on BNTI-seeded history. Association, not causation.
